name: Lotte Non - Life Insurance Co., Ltd.
summary: Lotte Non - Life Insurance Co., Ltd. is engaged in non-life insurance and reinsurance and insurance payment in South Korea. The company offers automobile, fire, casualty, long-term, marine, and retirement insurance products, as well as reinsurance products. It provides its products through professional Lotte consultants, bancassurance channels, and financial centers. The company was founded in 1946 and is based in Seoul, South Korea.
